title: 第27章 这不是建窑？
novel_title: 财神爷加好友！我被神仙团宠暴富(舒起起)
content_zh: 温栩栩还没开口，司凛已经往前站了一步，护在她面前。他低头看了一眼陈静手里那个爬着蟑螂的奶茶杯，冷着脸道：“你就是她舍友？”陈静一愣，这才看清眼前的人是谁。校草司凛。她的脑子飞快地转起来。司凛怎么会在这儿？还帮温栩栩搬行李？他俩什么关系？等等。陈静脑子飞快地转着，忽然想起平时在学校听到的那些八卦——司凛家是收藏世家，他爷爷特别喜欢建窑的瓷器。这事儿她们瓷器专业的同学课上还聊过，说司老爷子为了收一件建窑真品，满世界跑了三年都没找到。而温栩栩刚才抱着那个破罐子，口口声声说什么“宋代建窑”……陈静的眼睛一下子亮了。懂了。这穷鬼肯定是不知道从哪儿打听到司凛家的情况，故意骗司凛自已有建窑藏品，想攀高枝！难怪司凛会亲自来接温栩栩。不是因为这个穷鬼有什么魅力，而是温栩栩谎称有司凛爷爷想要的藏品！陈静的气焰瞬间又回来了，挺直腰杆，迫不及待想要揭穿温栩栩的谎言：“司凛同学，你别被她骗了！”“温栩栩怀里那个破咸菜罐，就是从保洁阿姨扔的垃圾堆里捡的！”“我亲眼看着保洁清理出来的破烂，她当宝贝似的抱着！”她故意把“垃圾堆”三个字咬得特别重，确保周围每个人都听得清清楚楚。“还宋代建窑呢？笑死人了！”“她就是知道爷爷喜欢这个，故意编出来骗你的！”周围的人脸上都露出恍然大悟的表情。难怪校草来找温栩栩，原来是温栩栩骗他说自已有建窑藏品啊！温栩栩懒得理会，扯了扯司凛的袖子：“别跟她计较了，走走走，我得赶紧把我的宝贝脱手。”她抱着罐子就要往车里钻。司凛却没动。他目光紧紧盯着温栩栩怀里那个灰扑扑的罐子，忽然开口：“栩栩，你等会儿，你确定你怀里的是建窑罐？”虽然他不知道温栩栩鉴赏古董的水平几斤几两，但是从她这财迷对这罐子的宝贝程度来看，不像是假的。司凛掏出手机，点开微信，翻出一个备注为“爷爷”的对话框：“我爷爷找宋代建窑瓷罐找了三年。能不能让我开个视频，给他看一眼？”温栩栩眨眨眼：“行啊！”她回答得那叫一个干脆，眼睛里都快冒金光了——要是司凛爷爷能看上这小罐，那岂不是省了她满世界找靠谱买家的功夫？收藏世家亲自鉴定，当场成交，一条龙服务！完美！她正要点头，忽然想起什么，赶紧补了一句：“那个……熟人归熟人，不打折哦。不能砍价哦。”语气那叫一个认真，生怕对方占了便宜。司凛愣了一下，低头看着她那张写满“我是财迷我骄傲”的脸，嘴角微微弯了弯。“放心。”“保证给你公道价。”温栩栩满意地点头，这才把怀里的罐子往前递了递。旁边陈静一听，直接笑出声，笑得前仰后合，眼泪都快出来了：“哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈——”她笑够了，擦了擦眼角，指着温栩栩对司凛说：“司凛同学，你是认真的？让她抱着个垃圾堆里捡的破罐子，去打扰你爷爷？”她走近两步，声音拔高，确保周围每个人都听得清清楚楚：“那可是你爷爷！收藏圈里德高望重的前辈！你让一个捡破烂的穷鬼抱着个咸菜罐子去请他老人家鉴定？？这不是打他脸吗？”旁边的人也跟着笑起来，窃窃私语声此起彼伏：“就是，骗人也不看看对象……”“司凛家什么级别，温栩栩什么级别，心里没点数吗？”“等会儿爷爷一看是假的，多尴尬啊，我都不忍心看了。”“说不定温栩栩就是想用这招接近校草呢？假装有个古董，一来二去就熟了。”“啧，心机真深。”陈静抱着手臂，一脸看好戏的表情：“温栩栩，我劝你现在赶紧认个错，说你眼瞎看错了，还能留点脸面。等会儿老爷子视频一开，假的真不了——到时候丢人的可是你。”她顿了顿，笑着补了一句：“当然啦，你要是非想丢这个人，我也拦不住。我就当看个乐子。”温栩栩视若无睹，抱着罐子往司凛身边凑了凑：“开吧。”很快，视频接通。屏幕里出现一位白发苍苍的儒雅老人，戴着老花镜，正低头看着什么。听到铃声，他抬起头，看见是孙子，脸上瞬间浮现出一种“懂的都懂”的八卦笑容：“哟，小凛？终于舍得给爷爷打视频了？”他推了推老花镜，眼神往孙子身后瞟：“听说你今天着急出院就跑去找一个姑娘？人呢人呢？让爷爷看看！”司凛面无表情地打断他：“爷爷，给您看个宝贝。”老人眼睛一亮，身体往前凑了凑，脸上写满了期待——然后看见镜头对准了一个灰扑扑的破罐子。老人的笑容僵在脸上。“……就这？”“等会儿，这什么东西？你专门打视频就为了给我看个咸菜罐？”老人越说越精神，眼神在屏幕边缘疯狂搜索温栩栩的身影，语气都兴奋起来了：“人呢人呢？让我看看那姑娘长什么样！你别光给我看罐子啊！”司凛：“……”他默默把镜头往温栩栩那边偏了偏，又迅速拉回来：“爷爷，您看看，这是不是建窑罐。”老人正要抗议，忽然听见“建窑”两个字。温栩栩眼疾手快，从包里翻出一张湿巾，三下两下把罐子底部的泥垢蹭了蹭，露出底足原本的模样，然后冲司凛使了个眼色——快拍这儿！司凛把镜头对准罐底。下一秒，老人直接从椅子上弹了起来，一把抓过老花镜戴上，整个人恨不得钻进屏幕里。老人皱着眉凑近屏幕，眯起眼睛看了两秒。然后——他手里的放大镜“啪”地掉在了桌上。“别动！”老人一声暴喝，整个人贴到镜头前，“镜头稳住！对准底部！慢点！再慢点！”周围彻底安静了。陈静张着的嘴还没来得及合上。刚才笑出声的那几个人，脸上的表情像被人按了暂停键。难道，这破咸菜罐还真是古董？温栩栩乖乖把罐子翻过来，对准镜头。老人盯着屏幕看了几秒，眉头忽然皱了起来。“嗯？”他推了推老花镜，又凑近了些，表情变得有些微妙：“小凛，你这罐子……”他顿了顿，摇了摇头：“不对啊。建窑出品，大多是小茶盏、小碗，哪有这么大的茶罐？”
content_en: Before Wen Xuxu could speak, Si Lin had already taken a step forward to protect her.He lowered his head and glanced at the milk tea cup in Chen Jing's hand that was crawling with cockroaches, and said with a cold face: "Are you her roommate?" Chen Jing was stunned for a moment, and then she saw clearly who the person in front of her was.The school's president, Si Lin.Her mind was spinning rapidly.Why is Si Lin here?Also help Wen Xuxu carry luggage?What's their relationship?etc.Chen Jing's mind was spinning rapidly, and she suddenly remembered the gossip she usually heard at school - Si Lin's family is a family of collectors, and his grandfather especially liked porcelain from the kiln.Their porcelain major classmate also talked about this in class, saying that Mr. Si traveled all over the world for three years to get a genuine kiln-building product but could not find it.And Wen Xuxu just held the broken jar and kept saying "Kilns were built in the Song Dynasty"... Chen Jing's eyes suddenly lit up.Got it.This poor guy must have found out about Si Lin's family situation from somewhere, and deliberately deceived Si Lin into having a kiln collection, hoping to climb high!No wonder Si Lin came to pick up Wen Xuxu in person.It's not because this poor guy has any charm, but because Wen Xuxu lied about having the collection that Grandpa Si Lin wanted!Chen Jing's arrogance suddenly returned, and she straightened her back, eager to expose Wen Xuxu's lies: "Classmate Si Lin, don't be deceived by her!" "The broken pickle jar in Wen Xuxu's arms was picked up from the garbage dump thrown by the cleaning aunt!" "I saw with my own eyes the rags cleaned up by the cleaning, and she held it like a baby!" She deliberately bit the word "garbage dump" very hard to ensure that everyone around her could hear it clearly."You are still building kilns in the Song Dynasty? It's ridiculous!" "She just knew that grandpa liked this, so she deliberately made it up to lie to you!" The faces of the people around her showed expressions of sudden realization.No wonder the school boss came to see Wen Xuxu. It turned out that Wen Xuxu had lied to him and said that he had a kiln collection!Wen Xuxu was too lazy to pay attention and tugged on Si Lin's sleeve: "Don't argue with her. Let's go. I have to get rid of my baby quickly." She held the jar and was about to get into the car.Si Lin did not move.He stared closely at the dusty jar in Wen Xuxu's arms, and suddenly said: "Xuxu, wait a minute, are you sure the jar in your arms is a kiln jar?" Although he didn't know how much Wen Xuxu's appreciation of antiques was, judging from how much she, a money-loving person, treasured the jar, it didn't look like it was fake.Si Lin took out his mobile phone, opened WeChat, and opened a dialog box with the note "Grandpa": "My grandfather has been looking for a porcelain jar from a kiln built in the Song Dynasty for three years. Can you let me make a video and show him a look?" Wen Xuxu blinked: "Okay!" She answered so straightforwardly that her eyes almost glowed with gold. If Grandpa Si Lin could like this small jar, wouldn't it save her the effort of finding reliable buyers all over the world?The family of collectors personally appraised the item, concluded the transaction on the spot, and provided one-stop service!Perfect!She was about to nod when she suddenly remembered something and quickly added: "Um...it's an acquaintance, so there's no discount. No bargaining." Her tone was serious, for fear that the other party would take advantage.Si Lin was stunned for a moment, looking down at her face that said "I am a money addict and I am proud", and the corners of her mouth curved slightly."Don't worry." "I promise to give you a fair price." Wen Xuxu nodded with satisfaction before passing the jar in his arms forward.旁边陈静一听，直接笑出声，笑得前仰后合，眼泪都快出来了：“哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈——”她笑够了，擦了擦眼角，指着温栩栩对司凛说：“司凛同学，你是认真的？让她抱着个垃圾堆里捡的破罐子，去打扰你爷爷？”她走近两步，声音拔高，确保周围每个人都He could hear clearly: "That's your grandpa! A highly respected senior in the collecting circle! You asked a poor rag picker to hold a pickle jar and ask his old man to identify it?? Isn't this a slap in the face?" The people next to him also laughed, and whispers came and went: "Even if you lie to people, you don't even look at the target..." "What is the level of Si Lin's family, and what is Wen Xuxu's level?, Don’t you have any idea?”“When Grandpa sees that it’s fake, I can’t bear to see it.”“Perhaps Wen Xuxu just wants to use this trick to get close to the school boss?”If you are wrong, you can still save some face.When the old man's video starts, it won't be true - you will be the one to be embarrassed."Of course, if you really want to lose this person, I can't stop him. I'll just watch it for fun."Wen Xuxu turned a blind eye and moved closer to Si Lin, holding the can."Soon, the video was connected.An elegant old man with white hair appeared on the screen, wearing reading glasses and looking down at something.Hearing the ringtone, he raised his head and saw that it was his grandson. A gossipy smile that "understood everything" instantly appeared on his face: "Hey, Xiao Lin? Are you finally willing to call grandpa?" He pushed up his reading glasses and glanced behind his grandson: "I heard that you were in a hurry to be discharged from the hospital today and ran away.Looking for a girl?Where is he?Let Grandpa take a look!" Si Lin interrupted him expressionlessly: "Grandpa, let me show you a treasure." The old man's eyes lit up and he leaned forward, his face filled with anticipation - and then he saw the camera pointed at a dusty broken jar.The old man's smile froze on his face."...That's it?" "Wait a minute, what is this? Are you making a video call just to show me a pickle jar?" The old man became more and more energetic as he spoke, his eyes frantically searching for Wen Xuxu's figure at the edge of the screen, and his tone became excited: "Where is the person? Let me see that girl.What does she look like!Don't just show me the jar!" Si Lin: "..." He tilted the camera towards Wen Xuxu and quickly pulled it back: "Grandpa, look, is this a jar for building a kiln?" The old man was about to protest when he suddenly heard the word "building a kiln."Wen Xuxu, with quick eyes and quick hands, took out a wet wipe from the bag, rubbed the dirt at the bottom of the jar three times, revealing the original appearance of the sole, and then winked at Si Lin - take a picture here quickly!Si Lin pointed the camera at the bottom of the jar.The next second, the old man jumped up from his chair, grabbed his reading glasses and put them on. He wanted to get into the screen.The old man frowned and moved closer to the screen, squinting his eyes and looking at it for two seconds.Then - the magnifying glass in his hand fell to the table with a bang."Don't move!" the old man yelled, leaning in front of the camera. "Hold the camera! Aim at the bottom! Slow down! Slow down!" The surroundings were completely quiet.Chen Jing's open mouth didn't have time to close.The expressions on the faces of those who laughed out loud just now seemed like someone had pressed the pause button.Could it be that this broken pickle jar is really an antique?Wen Xuxu obediently turned the jar over and pointed it at the camera.The old man stared at the screen for a few seconds and suddenly frowned."Huh?" He pushed up his reading glasses and moved closer, his expression becoming a little subtle: "Xiao Lin, this jar of yours..." He paused and shook his head: "That's not right. Most of the products produced by Jian Kiln are small tea cups and small bowls. How can there be such a big tea jar?"
